query: 反歧视政策 反歧视政策 衡量企业在招聘、晋升、薪酬及日常管理中，针对消除基于性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等特征歧视的承诺、规则与执行机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：明确界定了受保护的多元特征（包含但不限于性别、民族、生理状况等）；且规定了面向全员的反歧视/DEI 专项培训要求。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的反歧视声明或包含在员工手册中，具备基础的公平雇佣承诺。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“依法合规雇佣”表述。 二、执行机制得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：具备匿名举报热线；有明确的违规调查处理流程。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：缺乏明确的举报渠道或未说明处理机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：未采取实质性的合规管理行动。 反歧视政策 禁止就业歧视 受保护特征 公平雇佣声明 反歧视培训 无意识偏见培训 歧视投诉 歧视调查处理 多元与共融 anti-discrimination policy non-discrimination in employment protected characteristics equal employment opportunity employment discrimination anti-discrimination training unconscious bias training discrimination complaint discrimination investigation diversity and inclusion 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反歧视政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法合规雇佣”口号；仅有多元化人数统计而无政策；仅有客户反歧视营销政策；仅有反骚扰但完全不涉及雇佣歧视时可谨慎区分；区分：反歧视政策关注禁止基于特定特征的歧视及合规执行；平等机会措施关注选拔流程公平与监控指标；员工申诉机制是通用渠道， alone 不能证明存在反歧视政策。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights. results.text: The Group also organizes training camps from time to time on different topics to meet the needs of employees at different levels, including 'Sons of the Sea Cornerstone Camp', 'Haina Inclusion Camp', 'Employee with Potential Training Camp', 'Sales Manager Studying Camp' and 'Senior Management Power Camp'. In addition, the Group established a LAMPS system, in which employees can choose to develop themselves in-depth in different parts of the company such as management (LM), professional (P), sales (S), and administration (A). They can also choose to change their professions and develop themselves in breadth. The LAMPS system interrelates with various aspects that run through the human resources value chain such as personnel management, qualification standards, appointment procedures, business performance evaluation, opt-out mechanisms, and remuneration packages and fringe benefits. At the same time, the Group has established a human resources shared service centre to provide induction training and guidance for new employees to help them understand the company culture and integrate into the team quickly.
